sources.entry: ydl_api_ng - Simple youtube-dl REST API to launch downloads on a distant server. GPL-3.0 Python

summary.one_liner: ydl_api_ng is a webserver that exposes a REST API to start yt-dlp downloads on a remote server.
summary.what_it_does: The application runs as a webserver that accepts download requests through a REST API and performs the downloads on the host machine using yt-dlp. The README describes a default configuration that works without modification, plus customizable hooks that run on downloaded videos for further workflow steps. A browser userscript and an iOS shortcut are provided as ways to send download orders. The container version is described as bundling a full yt-dlp installation with its addons, scheduling of downloads, queue management, and multiple queues for managing resources. Documentation (installation, configuration, API usage examples, and a params.ini example) is said to live in the doc folder, which was not included in the README text provided.
use_cases: remotely download videos onto a home server
send download requests from a browser
download videos from an iPhone via shortcut
how_to_run: Installation with docker or without docker (see doc folder)
notable: REST API for submitting downloads to a remote server
Browser userscript and iOS shortcut for sending download orders
Customizable hooks to process downloaded videos
Container version with bundled yt-dlp, download scheduling, and multiple queues
caveats: Container-only features (scheduling, queue management, multiple queues) are not available in the non-docker setup
Documentation is referenced as living in a doc folder and is not included in the README text
